metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Detects execution of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe)
properties.description: Detects execution of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) with Addinroot. An adversary may execute AddinUtil.exe that point to the adversary's Addins.Store payload.
properties.query:
// Detects execution of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) with Addinroot. An adversary may execute AddinUtil.exe that point to the adversary's Addins.Store payload.
SecurityEvent
| where Process has "AddInUtil.exe"
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\-AddinRoot\:\."
  | extend
    ComputerName = tostring(column_ifexists("Computer", "")),
    Account = tostring(
        coalesce(
            column_ifexists("SubjectUserName", ""),
            column_ifexists("Account", "")
        )
    ),
    CommandLineMapped = tostring(column_ifexists("ServiceFileName", ""))
